name: ksr-guru-ji-app
description: KSR Guru Ji – Mobile App (PWA + Capacitor Android/iOS)

scripts.build: echo 'Building KSR Guru Ji PWA...' && npm run copy-www
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run build && npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run build && npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
